messages:
Rina: noticing ~4x pod evictions in ap-southeast1c over the past 15m, mostly tiny-worker-* and feature-extractors. Any idea what's up? :grimacing:
ops-bot: ALERT: gpu_evictions.ap-southeast1c = 5.2/min (10m avg). Cost anomaly detected: +22% in last 1h.
Tao: Are these preemptions or unschedulable then eviction?
Rina: a mix. Root thread: scheduler bind failures followed by eviction when larger jobs land. Dumped a few lines: ```kubectl get pods -n ml -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}' | tr ' ' '\n' | grep tiny-worker | wc -l
> 94
kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=prod-compact -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,LAB:.metadata.labels.gpu\.family,TAINTS:.spec.taints --no-headers | head -n 5
> gpu-node-21 rtxA [{"key":"nvidia.com/gpu","effect":"NoSchedule"}]
> gpu-node-22 rtx7  []
> gpu-node-23 rtxA [{"key":"nvidia.com/gpu","effect":"NoSchedule"}]```
Diego: We pushed the rtxA label enforcement policy yesterday morning. Looks like older images still have requiredDuringScheduling nodeAffinity for gpu.family=rtx7 which prevents them from landing on rtxA nodes even though rtxA has free GPUs. Small pods get packed onto a few rtx7 nodes and then evict when medium jobs need >1 GPU.
Aisha: Got it. Scheduler logs show frequent predicate failures: ```E0323 10:04:12.987 scheduler_predicate.go:98] Pod ml/tiny-worker-903 failed predicate: Fit failed: node(s) didn't match node affinity: node(s) had no matching labels```
Ben: Two quick options: 1) temporarily relax the node taint on rtxA nodes (NoSchedule -> PreferNoSchedule) so scheduler can place strict-affinity pods if needed, 2) enable an admission webhook to rewrite strict nodeAffinity -> preferred for pods with requests.gpu <= 1. I prefer the webhook for minimal infra churn.
Tao: Webhook rollout sounds safe but takes 30-45m to QA and roll. We need a hotfix for the eviction storm. I'll flip the taint effect to PreferNoSchedule on a small subset of nodes (3 nodes) in ap-southeast1c to observe behavior.
Rina: please also bump warmpool for that AZ by +8. We can shave off immediate schedule pressure.
ops-bot: RUNBOOK: warmpool_scale invoked by Rina at 2025-03-23T10:12:05Z -> warmpool.prod-compact.ap-southeast1c scaled 6 -> 14 (run id rp-4599).
Diego: running taint change now on gpu-node-21,22,23: ```kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-21 nvidia.com/gpu=present:PreferNoSchedule --overwrite
kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-22 nvidia.com/gpu=present:PreferNoSchedule --overwrite
kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-23 nvidia.com/gpu=present:PreferNoSchedule --overwrite```
ops-bot: NOTE: taint change applied to 3 nodes by Diego at 2025-03-23T10:14:09Z.
Rina: after the taint tweak, scheduling errors dropped. Snapshot from metrics: ```evictions.ap-southeast1c 5.2 -> 1.1 over 8m; unschedulable_count 42 -> 7```
Aisha: I'm going to start the mutating webhook canary to rewrite nodeAffinity for pods matching label "ml:tiny" to preferredDuringScheduling if requests.nvidia.com/gpu <= "1". Will roll to canary namespace first. Config snippet: ```apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration
... match: namespaces: ["ml"] labels: { "ml-tier": "tiny" }
patch: replace requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution -> preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution
```
Tao: Parallel action: I increased the binpacker scheduler's balance_threshold from 0.08 -> 0.2 to allow more mixed packing across families. This should reduce fragmentation but monitor for thermal or NVLink constraints.
Ben: Longer-term items for TICKET-4599: inventory remaining rtx7-critical workloads, create a CI gate to prevent required gpu.family on new images, explore extending scheduler scoring plugin to be GPU-fraction-aware (respecting fractional vGPU/co-scheduling). Also add a cheap admission check to warn developers.
Rina: opened TICKET-4599 "ap-southeast1c mini-pod eviction surge during rtxA label enforcement" assigned infra/runtime, linking logs and a list of impacted deployments + owners.
ops-bot: METRIC: evictions.ap-southeast1c = 0.8/min (now), cost anomaly attenuation in progress.
Diego: Can we also output a quick report of pods with required nodeAffinity across the cluster? ```kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.affinity.nodeAffinity? != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) -> \(.spec.affinity.nodeAffinity)"' | head -n 200``` I'll add the list to TICKET-4599.
Aisha: Canary webhook rolled to 12% of traffic in ml namespace. Early success: 60% of previously unschedulable tiny pods now scheduled on rtxA.
Tao: Plan if this doesn't stabilize: revert label enforcement for the rollout window, or cordon/raincheck problematic nodepool for controlled migration.
Rina: Great work. Monitor for 1h then ship the webhook to all ml namespaces if behaves. Thanks. :heart:
